dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Faint, low-contrast pale fringes are visible on the edges of the folded flight feathers against the primary gray plumage.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, high-contrast rufous-colored patch is visible on the nape, exhibiting a roughly rectangular to ovoid shape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and distinct linear boundary is visible where the rufous nape patch transitions into the uniform gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail features a high-contrast pattern consisting of large, circular white spots arranged in transverse rows across dark blackish rectrices.
